4th holiday: The day started really bad for me. But after a while I picked myself up and went out #cycling. After hanging around my red zone (my lungs didn't like it at all - too cold - reduced in the middle) I felt much much better. 👍 #CyclingTherapy 💜

#Strava Challenges: 2016: 1 (started with cycling at the end of year) 2017: 1 2018: 19 😯🤩 What a huge difference! With this in mind I will start 2019 no matter how hard it is. Despite of #depression I had a good year thanks to #cycling #HappyNewYear2019

Well done! I'm proud of you 👌 Keep running! I started slow and stayed a bit on a low level to adapt to exercise. Then I started to increase slowly. After two years with ups&downs I want to try the best I ever did in my life this year. 😊

Rollerblading along the river. I should not forget to go outside even though I'm training at home (indoor cycling). Staying at home in the weekend can encourage dark episides. Go outside against #depression and enjoy the light, nature and birds.

On the #BastilleDay2019 I took the opportunity to do a ride to the WWII monuments. This is the beautiful Hardt forest traffic free path. Can you imagine this was a brutal battlefield? #14juillet

At the pont de bouc. A memorial for the fallen. In 6 days 1500 victims. The fraternalism with the moroccan army is mentioned as "beautiful example". Many fought with the french army side by side. Dear passersby... Remember! Their sacrifice resulted your freedom!
Pont de bouc. This Canon 155H M1 fired over 7000 times. Both sides around 40'000 in only 6 days. At the end 14 civilians were trapped. It took 10 hours to evacuate them. 10h for only 4km under fire.

In the middle of the forest rests JEAN DEVIF. He was in a tank when he was shot. Evacuation Only 1.5km left for liberty. 3 girls (Paulette, Ginette & Marthe) were also killed. The victims are not numbers. They had names & are individuals. Mr Guyot cared for Devif's grave. 💐
